about: Setting groups every element gets (in addition to its own content settings and vsn_extras). R = responsive (3 anchors + advanced overrides, see responsive.json). Values default to the global design system (theme settings) so demos are built by settings only.

global_design_system.colors: color schemes (background, foreground, accent, button, button label, border, muted) — unlimited schemes
global_design_system.typography: heading + body + accent font pickers, type scale (display, h1-h6, body, small, label), letter spacing, text transform presets
global_design_system.spacing: spacing scale tokens (xs..3xl), section padding scale
global_design_system.radius: radius tokens (none, sm, md, lg, pill)
global_design_system.buttons: button variants (primary, secondary, ghost, link) with states
global_design_system.motion: motion presets (none, subtle, expressive), duration and easing tokens

background: image with focal point and art direction (R)
states: disabled — each with color, background, border, shadow, transform
motion: entrance animation (fade, slide, scale, reveal, split text)
visibility: show only to: logged in, customer tag, market/country, language, date range, product tag/type
dynamic: connect any text/image/link/number to a metafield, metaobject, product, collection, article or shop field
link: link to URL, product, collection, page, article, anchor

limits_to_verify: Shopify limits the number of settings and blocks per section/block and the size of schema; check current shopify.dev limits before Stage 7 and split settings across nested blocks if needed.
